methods.name: ACF, PACF, CCF, Box, PP and spectrum: the missing-value refusal names the column and the count R reports (RF-34)
methods.reference: stats::acf / pacf / ccf / spectrum / spec.ar refuse NA (na.action = na.fail); the count is sum(is.na(x)). Box.test (na.pass) and PP.test (NA statistic) do not refuse; p2a refuses with the same count
quantities: number of missing values in the refusal of each reader (x, xi, yi)
